"'''Buffy'''" was one of the thousands of small, flying [[CLE-004 window cleaning droid/Legends|CLE-004 window cleaning droids]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It worked together with an [[INS-444 window installation droid]] nicknamed "[[Mick/Legends|Mick]]," taking instructions from a central computer. Together, the two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] replaced the bedroom window of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] Coruscant [[Senate apartment complex/Legends|apartment]] after the original window was destroyed through the actions of [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid's name was first established in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''.
